kjv: thou (Israel) shalt call me (Yahweh) Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali (KJV 2:16)
mine: you (Israel) will call Me (Yahweh) 'My Husband,' and no longer ... 'My Baal.'
note: ishi "my husband" and ba'ali "my master/my Baal" are a pun on the god Baal; transliterating both leaves the English reader unable to see the point.
